speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs how much training are Police officers given in recognising mental health presentations and what is their course of action if they encounter such cases in carrying out their duties.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Singapore Police Force (SPF) equips Police officers with the skills to handle their jobs effectively through various structured and customised training programmes.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: During the course, officers are trained to handle different situations, including encounters with persons who show signs of mental illnesses.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: During the course, they learn techniques in dealing with situations where there are disputes or violence, including taking control of the situation, preventing escalation of violence, rendering and requesting for medical assistance, investigating possible offences committed and providing the parties involved an avenue for conflict resolution.

speaker: The Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The training would involve officers having to deal with situations where they come across people with mental health conditions.
